import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 100, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Filter out NaN values and get valid age data
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna()]['AlterVHundNum']
ax2.hist(age_data, bins=20, color='steelblue', edgecolor='white', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages')
ax2.axvline(age_data.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {age_data.mean():.1f} years')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Dog Gender Distribution by District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
gender_by_district = df.groupby(['KreisLang', 'SexHundLang']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
# Sort by total dogs in district
gender_by_district['Total'] = gender_by_district.sum(axis=1)
gender_by_district = gender_by_district.sort_values('Total', ascending=True).drop('Total', axis=1)
gender_by_district.plot(kind='barh', stacked=True, ax=ax3, color=['coral', 'skyblue', 'lightgray'])
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_ylabel('District')
ax3.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by District')
ax3.legend(title='Gender', loc='lower right')

# 4. Registrations Over Time
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
yearly_registrations = df.groupby('StichtagDatJahr')['AnzHunde'].sum()
ax4.plot(yearly_registrations.index, yearly_registrations.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         color='darkgreen', markersize=8, markerfacecolor='lightgreen', markeredgecolor='darkgreen')
ax4.fill_between(yearly_registrations.index, yearly_registrations.values, alpha=0.3, color='green')
ax4.set_xlabel('Year')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_title('Dog Registrations Over Time')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.93)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
